note: Allowed twin of step 1: the same source and the same ambiguous `1.5.kon`, with variable 6 pinned `sex` instead. Distinct slugs never collide, so `sex` publishes and family 5 alone stays withheld.

sources.description: Variable 5 delivers Kon (CVID 20) and KON (CVID 21) together in 2020; variable 6 delivers SEX (CVID 22) in 2020.
